excerpt.zh: 死灵机师协议的成功安装使我们得以将被击溃的特定星神兽复活。相比机械升级，有机组件是劣等的。我们可以改造肉体，制造出有机生命的复制品。
excerpt.en: The successful installation of Mechromancy protocols will enable us to reanimate certain deceased Leviathans. Organic components are inferior to mechanical upgrades. We can engineer the flesh and produce a facsimile of organic life.
